items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: And hadn't yet gotten to Earl Hines.

ctx.x: Yeah, of course, during those times there were a whole lot of guys that were playing that were favorite guys I liked to listen to. That's Guys during the time of James P. Johnson, the Lion and Fats and all those guys. And hadn't yet gotten to Earl Hines.
